newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Sept consumer price inflation 8.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Sept consumer price inflation 8.8 pct.

text.p: China's consumer price inflation rose 8.8 percent in the January-September period, compared with the year-ago period, the Financial News said on Tuesday.
The newspaper did not give a figure for September.
It said consumer price inflation was still relatively high, with house prices rising 11.4 percent and services 15.9 percent for the first nine months. It gave no further details.
Consumer price inflation was a year-on-year 8.1 percent in August alone.
China has already reported retail price inflation of 6.6 percent for the first nine months while the year-on-year rate for September was 5.0 percent.
